description: Check the status of your most recent balance-statement request. When READY, returns a time-limited PDF download URL. Not tax advice.

currency.description: Without requestId: scope to the latest statement for a specific filter (USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, MXN or CRYPTO; matches what you passed to generate_statement). null = the latest all-activity statement.

requestId.description: The requestId returned by generate_statement. Pass it to poll that exact statement; without it you get the most recent one.

name: get_statement_status
